display.title: Sefiras HaOmer: A Time to Be Sad and the Lesson of Rabbi Akiva's Students
display.summary_short: Why the days of Sefirah are a time of mourning, and how the mistake of Rabbi Akiva's students teaches us to respect one another and build Ahavas Yisroel.
display.summary_long: A short Sefirah talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi explains that serving Hashem with joy is a great mitzvah, yet, as Shlomo HaMelech said, there is a time for everything, including a time to be sad. During the days of Sefirah, between Pesach and Shavuos, we hold back from celebrations, do not buy new clothes or eat a new fruit that needs a Shehecheyanu, and do not take haircuts. This recalls Rabbi Akiva's thousands of students, who did not show each other respect and died in a plague that ended on Lag BaOmer. We should ask ourselves whether we make the same mistake, and show honor to everyone. Respect brings Ahavas Yisroel, which brings true unity, the secret weapon of the Jewish people, and in its merit Moshiach will come.
display.lesson: Show respect and honor to every Jew; Ahavas Yisroel and unity bring Moshiach.
